feeds.title: Modern MOH
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Megan- the voice behind Modern MOH! I'm a four-time bridesmaid, two-time maid of honor, and the one-time bride whose goal is to help you on your journey to becoming the GMOHOAT (greatest maid of honor of all time). Get tips and advice for any bridesmaid, maid or matron of honor. Information on planning the bachelorette and bridal parties.
